labeler_notes: Grid tables; text taken cell by cell (pymupdf find_tables) and checked against page images. Wrapped lines inside a cell are joined with ONE space per rule 1, even where the line ends in a hyphen or slash (e.g. '180- degree', 'non- Division', 'after- hours', 'Canebolt- Type', 'Hookbolt/ Deadbolt', 'Phone 800-253- 5668 | https://rwhardw are.com/company/ m ail@richardswilcox.co m or equal', 'AADSS1056147 &.pdf'); a checker may prefer no-space joins there. Set 05 description is the parenthesised remark on the title line '(see gate details on architectural drawings)' with parentheses dropped; set 27 description 'final to be selected' (leading en dash dropped). Rows whose catalog text spans the finish/mfr columns have finish/mfr null. Set 101 first row qty printed as '__' -> null. The last full-width 'Furnish all devices...' / 'Note: Furnish all devices...' row of each table is a set-level note and is excluded. Rotated copyright text in the left margin and text inside embedded pictures are not table text.
